name: gizza-ai/regex-extract
summary: Return every match of a regular expression in text

tool.description: Search text with a regular expression (Rust regex syntax) and return every match. Toggle ignore_case for case-insensitive matching, multiline so ^/$ anchor per line, and dotall so . spans newlines. Set capture_group to extract a specific captured sub-group instead of the whole match (0 = whole match), and unique to deduplicate the results in first-seen order. Returns the match count and the list of matches. Runs locally.

text.description: The text to search for matches.

pattern.description: The regular expression (Rust regex syntax) to match against the text.

multiline.description: Let ^ and $ match at line boundaries, not only the start/end of the text.

capture_group.description: Which capture group to return per match (0 = the whole match).

unique.description: Deduplicate the returned matches, keeping first-seen order.
